contests.title: Scituate town — Question 6: Advance notice of town-meeting floor motions
contests.scopeNote: Municipal electorate named in the official sample ballot; exact held Census county subdivision, excluding similarly named CDPs and school districts.

provenance.quote: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act regarding motions at the Town of Scituate annual Financial Town Meeting" be approved?

measures.questionText: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act regarding motions at the Town of Scituate annual Financial Town Meeting" be approved?
measures.officialStatement: This act requires prior notice and posting of motions to be made from the floor at the annual Financial Town Meeting of the Town of Scituate now held on the first Tuesday in the month of June. This requirement does not apply to special meetings held under R.I. Gen. Laws §45-3-6 or §45-3-7.

provenance.quote: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act regarding motions at the Town of Scituate annual Financial Town Meeting" be approved?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require advance notice and posting of motions made from the floor at Scituate’s annual Financial Town Meeting, held on the first Tuesday in June. The requirement would not apply to special meetings held under the two state-law sections listed on the ballot.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve that notice and posting requirement for the annual meeting, with the stated special-meeting exceptions.
